title: My quizzes
stopConfirmDescription: The room will be closed for all connected participants.
seatTaken: The host seat is held by someone else: you can only join rooms as a participant.
searchSessions: Search a room, a PIN, a host
browseTemplatesHint: Ready-made quizzes to create yours from — nothing is added to your bank until you ask.

cleanup.title: Clean-up
cleanup.waiting_one: — {{count}} still within its day of grace.
cleanup.waiting_other: — {{count}} still within their day of grace.
cleanup.stray_one: {{count}} file on disk with no media ({{size}})
cleanup.stray_other: {{count}} files on disk with no media ({{size}})

guard.empty_database: The database holds no media but the volume holds files: nothing is purged. Check that the database and the media volume belong together.
guard.database_older: Some media have lost their file: the database looks older than the media volume (restored alone?). Stored files are kept until they match.

cleanup.neverRun: No pass yet since the backend started.
cleanup.done: Done: {{adopted}} moved, {{media}} media, {{blobs}} files and {{files}} stray files deleted.
cleanup.busy: A pass is already running: try again in a moment.

delete.title: Delete this file?
delete.playing: A room is playing it: it cannot be deleted until the room closes.
delete.failed: The file could not be deleted.
delete.resultsLose: Past results no longer show it.
delete.everyCopy: Every copy of this file goes, whoever owns it.
delete.inCatalog: This file is one of the global media: deleting it also removes the copies hosts took of it, and their quizzes lose it. To stop offering it without touching any quiz, withdraw it from the Global view instead.

instance.help: Provided to every host, who find them under Global media in their library. Never cleaned up; withdrawing one never breaks a quiz. No alt text here: hosts write it for their quiz, in its language.
instance.addFailed: The media could not be added.
instance.empty: No global media yet: drop some above, or add them from the All view.
instance.removeDescription: Hosts no longer find it in their library. The quizzes that use it keep their copy.
instance.removeFailed: The media could not be withdrawn.
instance.saveFailed: The change could not be saved.
instance.drop: Drop images, videos or sounds here, several at once.
instance.unsupported: Not an image, a video or a sound.

preview.openFile: Open the file in a new tab

detail.empty: Choose a file to see it in full, where it is used and what can be done to it.

bulk.promoteFailed: Could not be added to the global media.
bulk.playing_one: Left out, a room is playing it: {{names}}.
bulk.playing_other: Left out, rooms are playing them: {{names}}.
bulk.unused: None of them is used: nothing breaks.
